note: Attacker-controlled glyph codepoint from the input buffer is passed as glyph_id to get_value
glyph_id is checked against num_glyphs from face->get_num_glyphs(); passes because glyph_id < num_glyphs

Returns pointer into arrayZ at offset glyph_id * sizeof(T); the array was sanitized to have num_glyphs entries, but the blob may be truncated so that only the format field is present and arrayZ points past the blob boundary

sanitize calls UnsizedArrayOf::sanitize which validates array bounds via check_array; if the blob is truncated exactly at the format field boundary, check_array may pass because the array is zero-length and the check is vacuously true

sanitize_shallow calls check_array which checks that count * sizeof(T) bytes are available; if count is 0 or the blob is large enough, the check passes even when the actual array data is uninitialized
check_range verifies base + array_size <= end; if the blob is truncated so that arrayZ starts at end, array_size=0 passes but any non-zero glyph_id reads past end
Caller dereferences the returned pointer; if arrayZ[glyph_id] is past the blob boundary, the read is from uninitialized memory, causing the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value crash
